newsitem.title: POLAND: Paribas gives Agros buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Paribas gives Agros buy recommendation.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets recommends investors to buy shares in Polish food producer and trader Agros Holding SA, saying the stock is undervalued despite its growth this year, Paribas said in its report.
It said in the report dated November 5 -- when the stock traded at 70.5 zlotys, more than three times its level in early 1996 -- it still expected Agros to grow by 20 percent.
"Although the share has risen dramatically this year, we believe that the price still undervalues the earnings potential of the company," it said.
It also praised Agros for focusing on the most dynamic sectors of the food market such as fruit juice production.
Paribas saw Agros's earnings per share rising to 6.4 zlotys in 1996, 7.7 zlotys next year and 10.2 in 1998, up from last year's 4.5 zlotys.
It saw Agros's group profit after tax rising to 62.5 million zlotys this year, 73.8 million in 1997 and 98.3 million in 1998, from 45.6 million.
Agros closed at 60 zlotys on Tuesday.
